'''Becker''' is a NPC male [[Startorch Academy#Rabelle College|Syncronist]] found at night nearby the [[Tactical Hologram: Synchronization]]. 

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Becker:''' Phew... finally...
:'''Emmie:''' You okay? I saw your sync rate spike by a whole new percentage point at the end there.
:'''Becker:''' I... What happened...? Did you help me?
:'''Emmie:''' No, I didn't touch anything. What happened?
:'''Becker:''' Just now, I felt like I'd hit my limit... I could barely hold on.
:'''Becker:''' And right then, it felt like [[Aemeath|someone]] stepped in to help me. Just enough so I pulled through.
:'''Becker:''' Who could it have been...?
{{Dialogue End}}
